package.name: Virtual Phone
package.description: Open a character's saved phone from Home → Phones, or use a story-aware phone inside a chat. Includes messages, browsing, notes, photos, and other phone apps. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents, then open the phone from the chat toolbar.
